layer1.name: Exec
layer1.one_liner: On-demand errands: someone competent for $25/hour, in under an hour.
layer1.description: An app that dispatched a vetted person to do whatever a customer needed — errands, moving, assembly — billed hourly. Later narrowed to on-demand home cleaning.
layer1.outcome_note: Wound down and sold. The founder's postmortem on online-to-offline businesses concludes the general-purpose errand model could not be made to work economically, and that the cleaning pivot was a different business.
